target.title: fix: show iOS chat activity after foreground refresh
target.body:
Closes #102308

AI-assisted: yes.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where iOS users who send a chat message and return to the chat during a long-running session would see an idle-looking transcript when the latest user turn was still unanswered and the session still had active work.

## Why This Change Was Made

The mobile chat view now renders the existing activity indicator when foreground history reports session activity but does not provide a chat `inFlightRun` snapshot. That fallback state is treated as blocking for sends/compaction, and it clears when a real run snapshot, assistant stream/tool event, terminal event, answered history/session message, session switch, reset, or timeout resolves the ambiguity.

The follow-up commit also moved existing session action methods into `ChatViewModel+SessionActions.swift` so `ChatViewModel.swift` stays below the SwiftLint `file_length` cap after adding the new active-session state.

## User Impact

iOS users get visible feedback that the assistant is still working after leaving and returning to a chat during a long-running run. The composer also stays guarded against accidentally sending another message into the same unresolved turn until the fallback activity state clears.
